Alex Chen: Quick sync 0: we need to recruit 46 design partners for Redwood Private (VPC+KMS) next quarter. Focus: security-first customers.

Maria Lopez: Agreed. Prioritize: finance/healthcare + current Dedicated customers >$10k/mo.

Samir Patel: Intake signals: Dedicated spend, support requests for on-prem/VPC, RFPs mentioning KMS.

Nina Park: Also flag teams hitting latency/token limits and those using long context models.

Alex Chen: Outreach DM (short):
``
Hi {Name},
Were running a small private preview of Redwood Private (VPC + KMS). Looking for a security-focused partner for a 4-week pilot: dedicated onboarding engineer, infra credits waiver, and migration help. Interested in a quick 20m sync?
 Alex
```

Maria Lopez: Offer two tracks: Fast-turn (4w) and Deep (8-12w). Set expectations about scope and backlog.

Samir Patel: Required partner deliverables: 3 prompt sets, route latency/error traces, weekly qual note. Success metrics: <1.5x baseline latency, KMS validated, purchase runway within 90 days.

Nina Park: Feedback loop: twice-weekly async + weekly 30m sync. Console telemetry visibility required; otherwise we provide weekly reports.

Alex Chen: Risks: KMS misconfig (runbook pre-check), cost overruns (credit caps), feature creep (product sign-off).

Emma Li: I can own onboarding for first partners.

Maria Lopez: Actions: Maria -> Typeform + tracking sheet by Thu EOD; Samir -> CRM tag DP-Private-Pilot; Alex -> send outreach to 6 targets; Nina -> Confluence checklist.

Alex Chen: Thanks, will start outreach. Ping here if blockers. :rocket:
